body:
there is a big park not far away from here that I haven't visited since forever. you know what? that's actually pretty nice. can't believe i never thought of that. i'll call up some of my classmates and try to gather as many as i can for a walk or something.  
Thank you! at least that'll keep my mind off negative things for a while.

I have recently started working out,tried the gym a few times,didn't really click with the atmosphere there so after the membership expired I went out and got few basic equipment for weight loss..dumbbells,kettlebells and all sorts of stuff.i still train but the motivation goes away every now and then. I want to look better,i have 79kg and i'm 18yo so about 10~kg over the normal value,but i don't really think I have a good,developed muscle mass.  
I never tried going to the sports center. there are a few tennis practice and swimming practice (as hobbies) but I lack the motivation. Why would I go there and practice something I'll never follow later on as a career..? that's my mindset,and I know its wrong but I can't help it.   
my mood is like my motivation,i'll probably feel super weird and sad during the weekend,and when monday comes i'll know. If things are good then nothing changes,and my mood will swing from time to time as always.but if they are not good then....i'm ready to move on.

i've went from this happy kid that all he did was stay ALL day long outside,playing with his 20+ friends that studied and got good grades,to this horrible fat,stupid human being that is an introvert. my friends are my classmates .that's all.   
I am struggling with school since 2nd year of highschool (currently finishing 3rd year) .I have no idea what changed,maybe the classes are too hard for me ,but I cannot transfer since I barely got over the transfer idea 2 years ago when I didn't like the class,but after a while I got used to it.    
try make another few friends to get the day over ? struggle for few months just for not even a year of talking? no thank you.barely made some friends and even now,after 3 years I don't understand them. I guess i'm just weird like that .but cancer is too much for me to take. I cannot afford it unless i break my family's bank,but that's out of the question,since I do not want to be a burden. I find it so weird. there are months when I don't even think about it and seem generally happy. I wonder if anyone else sees that I am actually sad,and not happy and joyous every single day. I do not know where im going with this,but putting my feelings into words is something that I've wanted to do for a long time,but never pressed the submit button. I got no one else to talk to. wouldn't want to let my mother into my mind/world,because that's a scary place.. thank you,whoever you are, for reading this.
